card.name: Words just before the word island
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected "Island" or "island", such as "the" after "on", "this", a possessive 's, or the name part "Jekyll" in Jekyll Island.

modes.label: Determiner before island
modes.description: "the" or "this" after a place word like "on", when the next word is island.
modes.example: who lived on<< the>> island of Lesbos in ancient Greece from

modes.label: Possessive or superlative before island
modes.description: A possessive 's or adjective like largest right before island.
modes.example: made many escape attempts in his time on Johnson<<’s>> Island. An attempt was made to tunnel

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word island or its translations coming next, so it acts as a brake on repeating that word.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be "island", as in "on the ..." or "Jekyll ...".
